public_rationale: Mistral's CEO publicly described a company established during the claimed interval that had grown to eighteen people building generative AI models. That is direct evidence of additional staffed work attributable to generative AI. It contradicts the ordinary reading that no new jobs existed. It does not settle whether generative AI increased total employment after accounting for displaced work.
limitations: The finding concerns gross job creation, not net employment or entirely new occupational categories.
The evidence is a company statement, not an independently audited employment series.
The availability date refers to the public conference statement; the transcript's separate posting date is not supplied.
